configurePresets.name: vs2022
configurePresets.description: Original generator. Keeps the .vcxproj/.sln workflow that the existing 'Build AiDAStandalone 2' VS Code task uses. Slower than the Ninja presets; use only if Ninja path has issues.

configurePresets.name: ninja-msvc-release
configurePresets.description: Production build. Uses Ninja for the build graph (single-graph parallelism beats per-vcxproj /m), sccache as the compiler launcher (caches every .obj keyed on preprocessed input — second clean rebuild is mostly cache hits), /Z7 embedded debug info via CMP0141 (no mspdbsrv.exe serialization). Run from a 'x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022' so cl.exe is on PATH.

configurePresets.name: ninja-msvc-fast
configurePresets.displayName: Ninja + MSVC + sccache (DEV ITERATION, no protector)
configurePresets.description: Dev-iteration preset. Same as ninja-msvc-release but skips the AiDAProtector POST_BUILD on the three protection targets, which alone takes ~5–15 minutes per full build. Output binaries are unprotected — don't ship them. Re-link only is what you usually want here.

configurePresets.name: ninja-clangcl-release
configurePresets.description: Clang-cl front-end with the MSVC ABI. Often 10–30% faster on very large C++ TUs because it parses headers more efficiently than cl.exe and works better with sccache hash caching. Requires LLVM in PATH (you have it at C:/Program Files/LLVM/bin).
